title: Umbel protected-resource metadata, version 1
description: The RFC 9728 document Umbel serves without authentication at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource<http.path> and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource in mode oauth (phase 5 section 3.3, D109; AFD's ProtectedResource::document, spec/authorization.md M7). resource is http.public_url, the only audience accepted; authorization_servers lists every issuer that issues tokens, in configuration order; scopes_supported is minimal, the rest arriving by step-up, and left out when empty; bearer_methods_supported is header only; resource_name is optional, and which name to publish (configuration version 5 has no key for it) is step 2a's. Nothing else is published, and mode gateway publishes none.

resource.description: http.public_url: https, a host, the MCP path, no user information, query or fragment.
